title: Validate collaboration record snapshots
responsibility: Define strict project and record schemas with identity, ownership and binding checks.

outputs.name: projectSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for project records requiring `id`, `name`, `sourceRepository`, `createdAt`, and `ownerId`; unknown fields are rejected. `createdAt` uses `z.iso.datetime()`, while the other fields use the imported `id`, `label`, and `repositorySchema` validators.

outputs.name: recordsSchema
outputs.description: Strict schema for version-1 snapshots containing `projects`, `members`, `invitations`, and `threads`; nested records are strict, timestamps use `z.iso.datetime()`, and comment text is trimmed to 1–20,000 characters with at most 100,000 comments per thread. It rejects duplicate project IDs, member `projectId/actorId` pairs, invitation IDs, thread IDs or per-project comment request IDs, records referencing absent projects, and projects without an owner member.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Calling `parse` on either schema throws when the value violates its validation rules. `recordsSchema` adds custom issues for duplicate record identity, unbound records, missing owners, and duplicate requests.
